Goals.Goal: Replace the invalid tracked active-directory marker fixture with a path-scoped HEAD archive check whose git and tar statuses are read separately and whose single entry is a regular file, plus an isolated minimal-project CLI probe green with the marker present and refusing with project.missing-change-directory when active/ is removed.
Refresh the derived test-metrics.json from one measured suite run so it records the renamed marker case with no provisional entries, without repairing the metrics runner.

No metrics-runner repair, no workflow retirement, and no inode, fixture, verifier, or duplicate-loader removal; those belong to the provisional later slugs named in Constraints.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-MARKER-WITNESS: The tracked active-directory marker test is red if the marker is absent from HEAD or its path-scoped archive, if either clean direction fails, or if removing active/ does not produce the named refusal. It asserts git ls-files --error-unmatch .ngrace/changes/active/.gitkeep exits 0; that a path-scoped git archive of HEAD restricted to the marker exits 0 with the git status read from the git process and lists exactly one regular entry, rejecting a symlink or directory, with the tar status read from the tar process; and that the extracted marker bytes equal git show HEAD:.ngrace/changes/active/.gitkeep. It lints the real repository with active replacement links intact at 0 errors and 0 warnings, then installs the archived marker into a separately constructed valid minimal GRACE project with no change bundles, drives real ngrace lint plus module find true, module find false, and module find --json=true green, and requires lint exit 1 with project.missing-change-directory and module find true nonzero once active/ is removed. It never fabricates an applied bundle, deletes archive history, or edits the fixture builder. The describe title stays tracked active-directory marker. bun test --timeout=0 scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts -t "tracked active-directory marker"
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-METRICS-REFRESH: test-metrics.json equals the JUnit-derived artifact of one measured suite run taken after the committed artifact was invalidated. It records the renamed marker case with its current title under scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts, contains no provisional entries, and is not left stale; timing values are not asserted and the metrics runner logic is unchanged.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CLOSE-LINT: Post-archive lint of the repository root exits 0 with zero errors and zero warnings, evaluated after this bundle's archive arrival. bun run ngrace lint --path . --fail-on warnings

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The plan anchors M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION and maps AC-METRICS-REFRESH to the task that invalidates test-metrics.json and refreshes it from one measured suite run, then checks the final artifact carries the renamed marker case and no provisional entries. Drive the marker property in both directions; prove the regular-file assertion rejects a symlink; read git and tar statuses separately, never through a pipe; and prove byte-comparison discrimination by changing one extracted byte and restoring it. The full CI-equivalent verification runs at close: bun run validate:ci. Post-close lint is a separate criterion.
